title: DualGR: Generative Retrieval with Long and Short-Term Interests Modeling
authors: Zhongchao Yi, Kai Feng, Xiaojian Ma, Yalong Wang, Yongqi Liu, Han Li, Zhengyang Zhou, Yang Wang
org_display: University of Science and Technology of China, Kuaishou Technology, Suzhou Institute for Advanced Research, University of Science and Technology of China
summary: DualGR针对生成式检索提出双分支长短时路由器、搜索式SID解码和曝光感知损失，在快手双列feed上实现显著线上提升，验证了工业场景下GR的可行性和有效性。
